svg.aria-label: Diagnostic reference card for the ETABS warning structure is unstable or ill-conditioned. Step one, switch to the Standard Solver. Step two, open the analysis log; a mock log shows a problem-joint table with columns for joint, problem type, digits of accuracy lost, and x y z coordinates. Step three, read the problem type. Lost accuracy means the model is ill-conditioned: sketches show overlapping elements, near-coincident nodes, an irregular fine mesh, and an extremely stiff element beside ordinary ones. Diag equals zero means the model is unstable: sketches show a column base with no support, a gap in a wall mesh, a brace released at both ends, and an internal mechanism. Step four, go to the flagged coordinates, fix that spot, and re-run until negative stiffness eigenvalues are zero.
svg.text: A diagnostic card for "structure is unstable or ill-conditioned".
* * * WARNING: THE STRUCTURE IS UNSTABLE OR ILL-CONDITIONED * * *
Slower. Accept it for this run.
same folder as the model file
≥ 11 digits lost = a target to inspect
it tells you which family you are in
nothing is loose; the numbers are badly scaled
two joints a few mm apart,
a rigid element, huge modifier or spring
a degree of freedom has zero stiffness
Gap in a wall or slab mesh
a linkage that can sway freely
Go to the flagged x, y, z. Fix that exact spot. Re-run with the Standard Solver.
Sign-off criterion: number of negative stiffness eigenvalues = 0. Anything else is quieter, not fixed.
